plugin.description: Shows live market prices and planning helpers for runeshape and expedition rewards.
debug.foreign_monolith: FOREIGN monolith (recipe-mode 0) - standalone "additional", not part of the Expedition dig, excluded from the route
debug.no_monoliths: No monoliths detected in this area.
debug.overlay_rows_count: Combinations panel rows: {0}  (open the panel to populate)
debug.unique_summary: Unique monolith (no anchor) - offers all recipes with size <= N ({0}).
expedition.buff_profile_help:
Weight each relic mod (a plain weight, not ex). A relic becomes a route target when its
sum(+ weights) - sum(- weights) is > 0; otherwise it's ignored. Both columns take positive
numbers - the - column is an avoidance penalty. Stored by internal mod id (any language).
expedition.effective_mods: distance {0:F0} grid - radius {1:F0} grid - {2} base  (reset each map)
expedition.last_plan: last plan: {0:F0} ms - A* {1} run = {2:F0} ms - {3} cached
expedition.target_profile_help:
Weight each reward marker (0 = ignore, blank types default to 1). Monoliths are
valued by their real reward price - this profile only weights the markers.
settings.draw_map_value_help:
Paints each monolith's best value (ex) on the large-map overlay, like
Radar's socket count (tinted by the threshold above). If it doesn't line
up with the monolith, match these to your Radar large-map settings:
settings.hide_map_values_panel_open: Hide map values while Combinations panel open
settings.highlight_locked_recipe_help: Gold border on the panel row of a sealed monolith's locked-in recipe.
settings.highlight_threshold_help:
Tints a monolith's header by its best reward value: green at/above the
threshold, yellow from 0.6x up to it, none below. 0 = off (use Price color).
settings.intro: RunecraftHelper: while the in-game Runeshape Combinations panel is open, the poe.ninja Exalted price is drawn on the right edge of each visible reward row. The reward name shown is the game's own (any client language).
settings.log_planner_decisions_help:
Writes a full decision trace on each Run (every candidate, its score,
rejections, gate openings, final pick) to expedition_planner_log.txt in the
plugin folder. For debugging why the route chose a path.
settings.min_markers_per_spare_charge_he:
After monoliths, a spare charge is used only if it covers this many
markers at once (normal maps; Grand routes every weighted target).
settings.monolith_min_ex_help: Monoliths with best reward at or above this are routed.
settings.monolith_debug_help:
Pick a monolith and dump everything the offer rule uses (anchor/p/N,
sockets-vs-station N, area level, addresses, and every offered recipe with
row/size/gate/category/reward/levels/rune pattern). 'Copy report' -> clipboard
for reporting a game-vs-plugin mismatch.
settings.monolith_rewards_help:
For each nearby monolith: its anchor rune + hole, and the candidate
recipes (from Expedition2Recipes.dat, filtered by the anchor) with
poe.ninja Exalted prices. Reads the anchor off the persistent device,
so it works even out of the network bubble.
settings.show_expedition_planner_help: A planner window appears while the in-game explosive HUD is visible
settings.show_glow_runes_help:
Labels a monolith on the large map with a watched rune found on a glowing
socket. Highest-weight match shows; ties show all. Defaults can be toggled off but not removed.
settings.show_route_spine_help:
Large map (Tab): draws the Router's strict-spine polyline (cyan) - the path
walked (detonator -> anchors), shown separately from the charge placements.
settings.total_charges_manual_help: Controller + HUD unreadable - set total to match the in-game counter, then Run.
settings.weight_profiles_help: Weight profiles (create / edit the tables in Settings -> Show route planner):
tooltip.route_stale: Settings changed - click to (re)build the route.
